title: Phones outside class
motion: Students should leave their phones outside class.
forPoints: Phones pull attention away from speaking practice.
A phone-free room makes pair work fairer.
Students can collect phones again the moment class ends.
againstPoints: Some students use their phone as a dictionary.
Families need a way to reach students in an emergency.
A total ban is hard to enforce and starts arguments.
usefulPhrases: I see your point, but I still think...
followUps: Would you ban phones only during speaking tasks?
How should a teacher handle an emergency call?
